channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: A Light-Toned Exposure in Tyrrhena Terra
item.description: The objective of this observation is to determine the nature of an exposure of light-toned material. This material appears in different spots in a Context Camera image. This picture is one of the most intense spots: that is, it shows quite a contrast with the surrounding ground. Pictures like these may be combined with CRISM data to better understand what is going on in this region. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
